Extremely unprofessional.
I ordered a memorial name plate to remember my partner who passed away last year. I ordered this on 11th July 2026. Was due to receive this at my home address in a couple of days. Now they tell me the item is out of stock. How can this be? It was personalised on 11th July and due to be delivered in a couple of days at my home address. 
This is not acceptable to treat a customer like this. Extremely unprofessional. Never will I use these again.

data.review_body:
have been waiting for my refund for over two months. Temu’s support team acknowledged that a refund via Fawry was impossible and explicitly requested my CIB Bank Account and Swift Code, which I provided immediately.
​Since then, I have received nothing but automated template responses from agents (like Jae Kim) promising "internal processing" without providing any real transaction proof, Swift advice, or ARN. They are completely ignoring my escalation requests to agent Magenus or a supervisor.
​This level of customer service is unacceptable. I demand an immediate human intervention and proof of my bank transfer, or I will proceed with formal international fraud reports via eConsumer.gov.
​Order ID: PO-060-12882713569911644
